prompt:
A hand-painted 2D game asset of a large brass telescope on a tall wooden tripod, standing upright and seen from the front, the tube pointing up and slightly toward the viewer. Polished brass barrel with engraved rings and a leather-wrapped grip, mounted on a dark walnut tripod with brass fittings and a small adjustment wheel. Handsome and expensive, the instrument of a captain with money. Brass, walnut and deep sea-blue palette.

Hand-painted 2D game asset. Soft gouache and watercolour with warm brown ink linework, visible brush texture, gentle washes rather than hard cel shading or airbrushing. Storybook illustration style. Flat even lighting from the front with only a soft contact shadow directly underneath. Not photographic, not a 3D render, no glossy highlights, no rim lighting.

STRICT STRAIGHT-ON FRONT VIEW. The object faces the viewer squarely. It is NOT rotated, NOT angled, NOT turned, and NOT seen in three-quarter or corner view - you can see its front face and nothing of its left or right sides. It is bilaterally symmetrical about a vertical centre line and stands perfectly upright. The camera is at standing eye level looking level and straight ahead. TALLER THAN IT IS WIDE, standing on the floor.

The object is centred and complete with a small even margin, standing alone on a FLAT SOLID PURE MAGENTA background, hex FF00FF, filling every pixel that is not the object. No floor, no room, no walls, no shadow cast onto the background, no gradient, no texture, no vignette.
